text:
Jordan (AE): Quick heads-up — Databank eval wants concrete IAM evidence for SSO + MFA enforcement, role mappings, and an example of least-privilege in prod. They asked for
   • SAML IdP metadata or metadata export,
   • MFA enforcement policy screenshot and audit log sample (success/fail),
   • RBAC role -> permission mapping CSV, and
   • short justification for least-privilege on our default roles.
Jordan (AE): Can security own the artifacts or do we want solutions to provide redacted logs? They need this by EOD Friday.
Maria (Security): I can own the checklist and deliverables. Need to confirm scope: is this for Hosted API only or Dedicated/Private as well? RBAC artifacts differ per deployment.
Jordan (AE): It's for their enterprise trial on Dedicated, but they also asked about Hosted — they want parity statements where applicable.
Maria (Security): Ok. For Dedicated we can provide:
   • SAML metadata (IdP and SP) — redacted SP ACS URL ok,
   • MFA enforcement policy screenshot from Console + sample auth logs with PII scrubbed,
   • RBAC role_mapping.csv (role_name,allowed_actions,resource_scope) redacted to exclude customer names,
   • one-paragraph least-privilege rationale for each default role.
Maria (Security): @Sam can you pull a 24h slice of auth logs and redact IPs/usernames? I just need success/failure counts and an example auth flow for MFA enforcement.
Sam (Eng): Yep, can do. Will run the query against prod-auth-log, scrub userids with hash, and include the header fields only. Example filter I'm going to run:
```
index=auth-prod sourcetype=auth:events earliest=-24h | fields timestamp,event_type,user_id,status,method | eval user_id=sha256(user_id)
```
Sam (Eng): Will attach a redacted CSV and a small JSON snippet showing an MFA success event.
Devin (Solutions): I can assemble the RBAC CSV and the least-privilege justification. Quick note: our 'support' role grants just read/list on customer resources; 'ops' includes token-create limited to specific clusters. I'll produce a mapping and a one-paragraph rationale per role.
Maria (Security): Great. For the SAML metadata, use the SP metadata export from the console, then replace the ACS and EntityID values with placeholders. Example note to include: 'This SP metadata is a redacted export; full values provided under NDA for Dedicated deployments.'
Jordan (AE): Do we have a pre-approved redaction template for security artifacts we can attach? They sometimes push back if we redact too much.
Maria (Security): Yes — use repo:/security/templates/redaction-guidelines.md. Also include an MD5 checksum of the original file and mention the fields redacted. We'll say we can provide full artifacts under the SOW / DPA.
Sam (Eng): Attached a sample MFA event (redacted):
```
{
  event_type: "mfa_challenge",
  user_hash: "b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184",
  status: "success",
  method: "totp",
  timestamp: "2026-03-18T14:22:33Z"
}
```
Sam (Eng): I'll also include a CSV with counts: total_auths, mfa_required_count, mfa_success_count, mfa_fail_count for the 24h window.
AuditBot: Policy scan completed for 'redaction-guidelines.md' — flags: none. See https://internal.redwood/sec-scans/5678 :white_check_mark:
Devin (Solutions): For RBAC mapping, sample row format I'm preparing:
role_name,description,allowed_actions,resource_scope,notes
support,Read-only customer support,read:list|read:get,customer/*,No write permissions
ops,Operational token management,create:token|delete:token,cluster:prod-us-east,Scoped to cluster IDs only
Devin (Solutions): I'll add a column 'least_privilege_rationale' with bullet points.
Maria (Security): One more ask from legal/reg — they sometimes want to see enforcement for MFA at the policy level. Include a screenshot of the Console policy page showing 'MFA required for all users' for Dedicated default org, with user emails redacted.
Jordan (AE): Noted. I'll tell the prospect we can deliver a redaction-pack + a short attestation letter that says: 'Artifacts redacted for PII. Full artifacts available under NDA/SOW.' Good?
Maria (Security): That's our standard. Also include the controls mapping to SIG/CAIQ rows: IAM-1 (SSO), IAM-2 (MFA), IAM-3 (RBAC). I'll add a one-pager mapping doc.
Sam (Eng): ETA: I can have logs + sample JSON within 4 hours.
Devin (Solutions): I'll draft RBAC CSV and rationales in ~3 hours, then hand to Maria for final sign-off.
Jordan (AE): Thanks team — delivery plan: Jordan sends redaction-pack + attestation to prospect by EOD Friday. Please upload final artifacts to the sales-sec dropbox link: https://redwoodcompany.box.com/sales-evidence/Databank-1772 (use folder 'Databank-Dedicated')
Maria (Security): I'll sign off once everything is in the dropbox. Ping me when uploaded. :thumbsup:
Jordan (AE): Will do. If any blockers I’ll escalate. Thanks all!
